# Reusable UI Components

*Navigation: [[index|← StashStats Index]] / [[web-app|Web Application]] / Reusable UI Components*
*Siblings: [[web-callbacks|Dash UI Callbacks]]*

StashStats provides modular Bootstrap-styled UI components for clean visual structure.

## Global Header Component

`create_header` renders the top navbar containing branding, sync state badges, and the account switcher pill:

```{.python include="../src/stashstats/web/components/header.py" snippet="header-component"}
```

## Component Library

- **Header (`header.py`)**: Environment pill, user avatar, and sync status indicator. See [[auth|Authentication & Accounts]].
- **Modals (`modal.py`, `account_modal.py`)**: Dialogs for account switching and credential validation.
- **Analytics Charts (`analytics_charts.py`)**: Plotly figures for weight distribution, fiber pie charts, and velocity bar charts. See [[analytics-distributions|Categorical Distributions]] and [[analytics-velocity|Consumption Velocity]].
- **Stash Accordion (`stash.py`)**: Hierarchical accordion list grouping packs under parent commercial yarns. See [[models-stash|Stash Domain Models]].
